item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi bsad las gnam lcags thog mda'
item.coloph: de ltar bsad pa'i las tshogs 'di/ sgrub gshen lha sngags ting 'dzin ni/ dbang thob rdul shugs can gyi skal/ dam med can la gsang rgya sdom/ las ldan rnams kyis gter 'di bzhes/ dus mtha' bon chos ru 'gran skabs/ zhang zhung sgo mo'i gnas kyi phyogs/ zangs brag ri la gter du sbas (sbos/)gter srung rnams kyis bya ra gzob (gzobs/)phyis su nges med gshed bzhi los/ zab gter rnyed pa'i smon lam thob// phyis su bdag 'dra gshen spral ne skya nyi ris zab mo gter gyi dngos grub rnyed ste (de/)lo mang gsang rgya sdom (bsdams) hor sras mchog dang grwa btsun 'ga' nas bskur (bskul) ngor/ shog ser brda' yig 'ol tsam las/ rig pa'i 'phrul gyis drangs te spel ba'o//
